content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen stacks a sticky Pokličite/Navodila bar, a hero photo, headline and then two more text links (Pokličite me, Oglejte si cene), so the call action appears twice above the fold.","desktopNote":"The hero sits in a tall white band with ~110px of dead space under the photo, and the price strip below is left-heavy with an empty right half, making the top of the page feel loosely composed.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Remove the duplicate 'Pokličite me' text link from the hero (and the dark CTA band repeats it again); keep one primary call action per screen and let 'Oglejte si cene' be the hero's secondary link.","Tighten vertical rhythm on desktop: cut the empty space under the hero and the half-empty 'Kaj delam' and 'Kdaj delam' two-column blocks, or fill the right column of 'Kdaj delam' with address/map.","Make the hero photo full-bleed or larger (crop to the hair, not the salon background) and use the bride photo as a second visual in the services list to break the long text-only run of seven rows."],"blockers":[]}
